test_title: PYST 21: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 9th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Excerpt
solution:
The correct answer is 'Extract'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let's take a look at the given word and the marked option:

 
 
• Excerpt: a short extract from a film, broadcast, or piece of music or writing.

 
 
• Example*:** *An excerpt from her new thriller will appear in this weekend's magazine.
 
 
 
• Extract: a short passage taken from a piece of writing, music, or film.
 
 
• Example:* *They published an extract from his autobiography.
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus from above, we can say that the correct answer is option 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Abstract: a summary of the contents of a book, article, or formal speech.
 
• Interval: an intervening time or space.
 
• Blurb: a short description of a book, film, etc., written by the people who have produced it, and intended to make people want to buy it or see it
